subject: Welcome — pick a time for your product walkthrough
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Sands <olivia.sands@nebulaanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome — pick a time for your product walkthrough

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for signing up and welcome to Redwood Inference. I'm Monica on the Solutions team — happy to get you a short walkthrough so you can see how we handle low-latency inference and multi-environment deployments.

We hold 20-minute product walkthroughs that focus on what matters to engineers: latency profiles, deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private), and integration patterns. To make scheduling quick, please pick any slot from my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/monica/20min

If you'd like an engineer-heavy session, reply with "Engineer" and I'll add Markus (our AE) to the call. If you need a different timezone window, let me know and I can propose alternate blocks.

Attached is a short one-pager that highlights typical use-cases and the runtime benefits (for reference).

Best,
Monica Patel
SDR, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference

- Do you have a public pricing outline or a ballpark for reserved capacity? Our procurement will ask.

If 30 minutes is better, happy to move to a block later today. Otherwise we'll keep 11:30 and Arjun can stay for the first 20 and then follow up.

Options for today:
- 11:30–12:00 PT (the slot you picked) — keep as-is
- 13:00–13:30 PT — second slot I can open if you prefer the extra time

Quick pricing note (ballpark): reserved capacity commitments typically start in the mid-five-figure/month range for small production pools; exact quotes depend on GPU mix, throughput targets, and retention settings. Markus will run numbers with you.
